objective: Measure the independent causal contribution of replacing an overlong but self-sufficient exact evidence span with its exact atomic surface to strict v4 schema recovery on the frozen external-holdout raw responses.

intervention.name: represent_long_self_sufficient_evidence_by_exact_surface
intervention.operation: Replace only source_text with the existing surface_item. Preserve semantic_item, surface_item, role, category, level, relation, group_name, allow_other, qualifier, every fact mention, and record metadata exactly.
forbidden_changes: changing any atom other than an eligible atom's source_text
loading or applying the absent-fact omission oracle
using gold, model, network, parser, or canonicalizer output

criteria: Exactly 10 eligible source_text values change in only the Atira target.
Atira changes from strict-schema invalid to strict-schema valid.
All four negative controls remain strict-schema invalid for their original empty-fact errors and remain byte-identical.
Every replacement is at most 240 characters and remains an exact substring of both its original source_text and the full job body.
Every non-source_text atom field, every noneligible atom, and every fact mention remains byte-identical and in order.
Restoring the ten audited original source_text values reconstructs the frozen raw exactly.
The frozen raw input hash is identical before and after evaluation.
No other oracle output, model, network, parser, or canonicalizer is used.
acceptance_gate.falsification: Reject this representation mechanism as independently sufficient for Atira if Atira remains invalid, any replacement loses exact anchoring, or any control changes.
acceptance_gate.interpretation_limit: Even full support explains only the observed self-sufficient overlong spans. It does not cover null surfaces, semantic/surface divergence, other long-span forms, or unseen-data generalization.

next_allowed_action: Implement and freeze only the long evidence span oracle runner, then execute it once from the frozen external raw.
